g.text: Sampled path — one point per second

svg.metadata:
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
# Reference figure for genre `block` — NORMATIVE surface only (spec/genres/block.md). # Every construct here is inside the v0.1 conformance surface and the # compatibility promise. Experimental constructs are in block-experimental.fd. # The set demonstrates every FORM of every keyword, not just every keyword. # Coverage: node tools/reference-coverage.js --normative-only --strict block figdown 0.1 block title "Metrics ingest datapath"
# `class` declares a meaning ONCE; elements join it with class=. The meaning # string is required — it is what a reading agent gets instead of a hex value. class sampled "Sampled path — one point per second" stroke=#b91c1c class draft "Provisional — not in production yet" style=dashed class audit "Audited — 30 day retention" fill=#fef3c7 # A class MAY declare that it claims no meaning (`CLASS-EMPTY-MEANING`): the meaning string is # still REQUIRED, but written empty it says "this is pure attribute grouping — # one name applied to many members so a shared look is written once". The # difference is visible in the output: `tint` gets NO legend entry, because a # legend lists meanings and this class has declared it has none. Omitting the # string entirely is still a line error — silence and "nothing claimed" are # different statements, and only one of them is checkable. class tint "" fill=#f8fafc
# `external` is the outside world an edge enters from or leaves to. It is never # drawn as a shape (`EXTERNAL-EDGE-ENDPOINTS`) and has no id fallback: all three label states below # draw no box, and only the first draws text. external wire "from the wire" external drop "" # written empty label — deliberately textless (`EMPTY-LABEL-STATE`) external ops # no label written — absent, not "ops" (`OMITTED-LABEL-RECORDING`)
# `group` is containment; membership is declared with in= on the member, never # inferred from geometry. One level only — `group ... in=` is a line error. group ingest "Ingest" fill=transparent style=dashed # A `#` inside a QUOTED STRING is ordinary text (core §1) — `#0` is the ring # number and opens no comment. That holds in all four verbatim regions: a # quoted string, an `[edge label]` (`VERBATIM-REGION-SCOPE`), a comment, and a GFM pipe row. node rx "RX ring #0" shape=box style=solid in=ingest class=tint node dec "Decode" shape=rounded in=ingest class=tint # No label written: the model records it ABSENT and the renderer falls back to # the id (`OMITTED-LABEL-RECORDING`). This is how a shape whose caption you could not read is # transcribed — never invent one. node dedup in=ingest
# `shape=diamond` needs a demonstrator under a scene genre and this is it — but # the LABEL is a selector role, not a question. A diamond asserts nothing a # reading agent can recover (shape is presentation), so under `block` a # question label makes the figure LOOK like a flowchart while stating none of # what that genre's words state. This is the sanctioned mux/selector interim: # keep the geometry, put the role in the label. node gate "Selector" shape=diamond # Written empty label: the model records "" and the renderer draws no text # (`EMPTY-LABEL-STATE`) — an unlabelled tap point, without inventing a word for it. node j "" shape=circle
# No label on the group: the caption falls back to the id, as on a node. # gap=0 is exact member spacing — flush, the one-frame-with-dividers look. group store gap=0 fill=#eee node cache "Hot cache" shape=cylinder in=store node tsdb "Series store" shape=cylinder in=store
# The third caption state, on a group this time (`EMPTY-LABEL-STATE`): `ingest` is captioned, # `store` writes no label and falls back to its id, and `""` is the author # saying there is no name for this grouping — a frame that claims only "these # belong together". Transcribe a source figure's unnamed box this way; naming # it "Group 1" asserts a category the original never claimed (`TRANSCRIPTION-FIDELITY-TIERS`). group tap "" style=dashed node span "SPAN copy" shape=box in=tap node sink "Mirror sink" shape=box in=tap
# class= takes a comma-separated LIST. The channels apply left to right and the # later class wins per channel; here they touch different channels, so the fill # comes from `audit` and the dash from `draft`. node peer "Peer region" shape=ellipse class=audit,draft # Option position is free on every directive (`OPTION-POSITION-PARSING`) — before the label or after. # fill= takes #rgb, #rrggbb, a CSS colour name, or transparent. node fill=gainsboro cfg "Rule set"
# Four operators — `->` `<-` `--` `<->` — each written bare below and again # with a [mid] label, which splits the operator into halves. edge wire [eth0] -> rx edge rx -> dec edge dec -[flags[3:0]]-> dedup # balanced inner brackets nest verbatim edge dedup -> gate edge cfg -[rules]- gate style=dotted edge cfg -- dedup style=dotted edge drop <-[dropped]- gate edge gate -["keep\n(sampled)"]-> j # quoted form: for \n, quotes, unbalanced [ edge j -> cache class=sampled # The written form IS the model: `<-` runs second->first and is never rewritten # to `j -> tsdb`. Statement order is the author's focus, so it is preserved. edge tsdb <- j edge cache -> ops stroke=#2563eb # an edge has no interior: stroke= is its line edge gate -[copy]-> span style=dotted edge span -> sink # All three label positions at once: near the tail, on the line, near the head. edge tsdb [1] <-[replicate]-> [N] peer class=draft edge cache <-> peer class=draft
flow right # right|down|left|up — one per document; `right` is block's default # `rank` states that these elements are PEERS — same position along the flow # axis (same column under `flow right`, same row under `flow down`). It is # CONTENT, not layout: "these are peers" survives the `GUI-WRITEBACK-STRUCTURE` strip test, `pin` # does not. The comma form is canonical; `rank cache tsdb` # still parses. Do NOT rank a chain that edges already order (rx -> dec -> # dedup): that flattens the mainline sideways. See guide/layout.md §8. rank cache,tsdb
# Everything below is geometry with no meaning, and a reading agent skips it by # default (`CONTENT-LAYOUT-ZONE-SPLIT`/`GENRE-NAMESPACE`). Removing the whole zone leaves the same figure meaning — # that is the `GUI-WRITEBACK-STRUCTURE` invariant tools/strip-check.js tests. Pin only what auto-layout # gets wrong (`LAYOUT-STABILITY`): every pin is a promise later edits must keep. layout pin wire at=(0,80) # anchors the left edge so the pins below hold still pin cfg at=(554,150) # canvas px; inside a pinned group, member pins are group-local pin j at=(721,41) pin drop at=(713,140) # an external is pinnable exactly like a node pin cache width=120 # width only pin tsdb width=120 height=46 # both pin peer height=46 # height only
